reviewedBy: Roadmark WS2 refresh (Claude Code worker), Lexus

sources.title: Lexus Australia to launch ultra exclusive RZ 600e F Sport Performance flagship (Lexus Australia news)
sources.supports: Opened 2026-11-05 with Disclaimers expanded. 'Lexus RZ pricing': RZ 600e F Sport Performance $135,000; RZ 550e F Sport $104,920; RZ 500e Sports Luxury $91,000; RZ 500e Luxury $84,500. Footnote 1: manufacturer's recommended retail price provided for media purposes only; statutory charges or other on-road costs not included. A dated news release, not a live price list.

sources.title: All-New Lexus ES a new generation of luxury sedan (Lexus Australia news)
sources.supports: Opened 2026-11-05 with Disclaimers expanded. '2026 Lexus ES pricing': ES 350e FWD Sports Luxury $77,000; ES 500e AWD Sports Luxury $84,000 (also ES 300h models). Footnote 7: manufacturer's list price provided for media purposes only; statutory charges or other on-road costs not included; optional colours or features at additional cost. A dated news release, not a live price list.

sources.title: Lexus Build and Price, RZ
sources.supports: Opened 2026-11-05. Build and Price page loads for the RZ with a 'See drive away price' step that needs a location; the driveaway price was not requested. No order status or stock stated.

availability.note: RZ is listed with Build and Price, dealers and test-drive routes; order acceptance and stock not stated.
